scientific_integrity: The symbolic proof derives the full group structure and all-n count; an independent finite checker verifies the defining two-point condition in small orders. No external or independent expert verification has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for ordinary dihedral groups of order 2n, n >= 3, with the n=1,2 boundary cases explicitly included. It does not treat noncyclic generalized dihedral groups, one-point local maps or arbitrary finite groups; exhaustive checks cover only n <= 8. Cyclic congruence-block symmetry has substantial existing literature and historical priority for the combined classification has not been independently audited.
title: Two-local automorphism groups of finite dihedral groups
